# Metabolic_Neural_Feedback_Loop

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A regulatory circuit where microbial metabolic products influence neural activity, which in turn alters metabolic outputs, creating a closed-loop homeostatic system. Serves as a biological template for energy-aware TCC architectures that balance computational load with resource availability via feedback control.
